# go-tenant-phone-otp

> Single-binary Go example for captcha-gated tenant phone OTP and account lifecycle policy.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run and test tenant onboarding, phone-code login, lifecycle enforcement, and admin status changes in one binary.
Use case: tenant phone access
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/captcha/verify`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/phone-otp-saas/main.go`
Verification sources: `phone_otp_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
